Select molecule_chembl_id, canonical_smiles
Join activities on activities.molregno = molecule_dictionary.molregno
Join assays on assays.assay_id = activities.assay_id
Join target_dictionary on target_dictionary.tid = assays.tid
Filter target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL2146302'
Filter target_dictionary.organism = 'Homo sapiens'
Join compound_structures on compound_structures.molregno = molecule_dictionary.molregno
Return molecule_chembl_id as compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles
Sort by compound_chembl_id
